- [LTES.5.3.2] **Deterministic.** Given the same event trace and the
  same compiled rule set, the runtime must produce the same
  observable output (rule activations, emits, calls, cache
  operations, operator-log entries) on every run,
  byte-for-byte. No hidden non-determinism, within a platform
  or across platforms: every v1 result is cross-platform
  bit-identical ([LDET.3.4.1]), so a harness compares the
  same way in both cases. See
  [LDET] for the full guarantee,
  implementation commitments, and rule-firing-order
  specification.
